project.kredit-raksa-analytica.title: Kredit Raksa Analytica
project.kredit-raksa-analytica.descripti: Precision and Objective Automated Credit Eligibility Analysis
project.kredit-raksa-analytica.content:
As the developer behind this platform, I realized that the biggest bottleneck in the traditional consumer credit application process lies in the time-consuming manual document validation. Therefore, I designed Kredit Raksa Analytica as a web-based smart engine that simplifies, accelerates, and improves the accuracy of assessment for each prospective customer. This application doesn't just store data; it actively processes crucial financial indicators to produce credit decisions that are far more measurable, fast, and free from human bias.

The main focus I built into this system is the computational capability to analyze the repayment capacity of prospective customers in depth. Kredit Raksa Analytica automatically calculates debt-to-income ratios, tracks financial history, and measures the liquidity value of collateral. Through this data-driven approach, the system can instantly map the customer's risk profile and provide objective decision recommendations, thereby suppressing the risk of Non-Performing Loans (NPL) from the early application stage.

Not only assessing basic eligibility aspects, I also injected a special algorithm to determine the ideal credit limit (plafond) for each individual. Based on cross-calculation between the adjusted market value of the collateral (haircut) and the customer's remaining net income, the application will recommend the safest and most rational application nominal figure. This feature ensures that the consumer credit facilities provided are truly aligned with the customer's real capacity, maintaining the bank's liquidity balance while protecting the customer from default risks in the future.

By integrating this entire workflow into a dynamic dashboard, I successfully cut down credit review bureaucracy that used to take days into a much simpler process. Kredit Raksa Analytica is the technological solution I built to transform conventional analysis systems into a smart digital ecosystem. Through this application, I wanted to ensure that PT. BPR Raksa Wacana Agri Purnama has a competitive advantage in distributing consumer credit safely, efficiently, and precisely.
project.digital-bank-raksa.title: Digital Bank Raksa
project.digital-bank-raksa.description: Online banking system for customer complaint handling, digital credit applications, and account opening.
project.digital-bank-raksa.content:
In an era where time is the most valuable asset, efficiency in managing finance is no longer just an option, but a necessity. For a long time, we have been used to setting aside special time amidst busyness just to come to branch offices, queuing, and filling out physical forms to open savings accounts or apply for credit. Not infrequently, our daily activities stop for a moment when our marketing team comes to do door-to-door visits to help with your administration process manually. We highly value every handshake and personal interaction, but we also understand that your mobility is very high and valuable.

As a form of real commitment to grow with community welfare, PT. BPR Raksa Wacana Agri Purnama takes adaptive strategic steps. Through the presence of the Digital Bank Raksa platform, we redesign the entire traditional banking service ecosystem to be more modern, responsive, and easily accessible. This digitization step doesn't mean we reduce the essence of closeness with customers, but rather our way of always being present 24/7 by your side. We want to ensure that the warmth and security of the services you usually feel at branch offices can now migrate perfectly into your phone screen.

Now, financial convenience is absolutely in your hands without boundaries of distance and time. Starting from opening new savings accounts, depositing, to customer complaint services can be solved in just a few taps online. You no longer need to worry about left-behind physical documents or matching time with office hours. This intuitive and secure platform format ensures all administrative data is processed instantly, transparently, and confidentially, giving you full control over daily financial decisions independently.

Furthermore, for those of you planning business expansion or fulfilling personal needs, this platform is integrated directly with the Kredit Raksa Analytica system. Through a smart backend, the consumer credit application process is now much more practical and objective. Our marketing team no longer has to visit your home manually just to collect documents; you simply upload requirements documents directly to the system, and our analyst team will immediately follow up quickly. Together with Digital Bank Raksa, let's leave the complexity of the old way and step confidently towards a banking future that is smarter, simpler, and more trusted.
